title: Not Your Backdrop
summary: A Rothko Seagram mural that withdraws itself the moment it is embedded as someone else's decoration.
mechanism: Frame-bust detection (window.self !== window.top) blanks the painting to a refusal when iframed; a button feeds the page's own source to an inline <iframe srcdoc> copy that withdraws on cue, no network.
references: The Four Seasons / Seagram Building commission, withdrawn by the artist 1959
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
